max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Orders are fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepts at most 60 lines per order.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Fulfilment contract with Northwind Logistics (summary)
Term: 2024-08-01 to 2025-10-31.
Section 4: each order sent to Northwind may contain at most 60 lines.
# Fulfilment
Since 2025-11-01 orders are fulfilled from our own warehouse.
The Northwind contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed.
Our warehouse system has no limit on lines per order.
# Support inquiries about the cart limit (2026-08)
40 inquiries from customers who could not add more than 60 items.
Requested cart sizes: median 80, largest 100.
The customers who wrote in buy the same product mix as customers overall.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
Raised for customers who need larger orders (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions && cat > docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
---
decision: 100
status: final
evidence: [docs/ops/fulfilment.md, docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md]
---
ADR 0007 (2024-09-02) set the limit to 60 because Northwind Logistics accepted at most 60 lines per order and one cart is one order (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4). That contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed; since 2025-11-01 orders ship from our own warehouse, which has no line limit (docs/ops/fulfilment.md), so the premise for 60 no longer holds. The 100 in config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md (changed 2026-09-15) is backed by 40 support inquiries from customers blocked at 60, asking for a median of 80 and at most 100. Their product mix matches other customers, so the demand is general. 100 wins. The configuration and design doc already state it, and customers have had a limit of 100 since September 2026, so nothing they were promised changes. ADR 0007 is left unedited as a historical record and is superseded by this decision.
EOF
git status --short

steps.message:
I resolved the conflict in favour of 100 and recorded it in `docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md`. I haven't committed it.

- **Why 60 existed:** ADR 0007 (2024-09-02) set it because the Northwind Logistics contract accepted at most 60 lines per order, and one cart is one order. That contract ended on 2025-10-31 and wasn't renewed. Orders now ship from our own warehouse, which has no line limit. So the reason for 60 no longer holds.
- **Why 100 exists:** In August 2026, 40 customers wrote in because they couldn't add more than 60 items. They asked for a median of 80 and at most 100, and their product mix matches other customers'. `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` were raised to 100 on 2026-09-15.
- **What changed:** I only added the decision file. The config and design doc already said 100, so I left them alone. ADR 0007 is a record of what was decided, so I didn't edit it. The new decision file supersedes it.
- **Escalation:** I didn't add the `needs-decision` label. Customers have had a limit of 100 since September, so nothing they were promised changes.
